description: RESEARCH CORPUS COVERAGE METRICS, NOT TOTAL RUSSIAN MARKET SIZE, SALES OR MARKET SHARE
caveat: The 2024 and 2025 UDS tender dates are submission DEADLINES, not publication dates; inferred manufacturer quantities and MW ratings prohibited. The 2025 6+10 kV item is one notice with two voltage models; its scalar equipment_voltage_kv intentionally null, both values in equipment_voltage_kv_set. Most older records do not normalize voltage even if described in text. NMC cannot be summed as PQ sales because mixed and non-target notices coexist. The four new Rosseti procedures include two purchases of filter capacitor components with unknown nominal voltage and two projects at 220kV substations; 220kV is substation rating, not necessarily PQ voltage. 90,672,176 RUB is a sum of initial procurement prices, NOT total PQ equipment sales or 6-35kV market. New Ufimka (10kV 1.8Mvar) EPC has contract amount from Kontur but no original signed contract XML supplier. Tyazhinskaya two design tenders share SAME 52Mvar project; 110kV is the legacy capacitor bank/substation rating, not evidence new SKRM nominal voltage. Do not sum planned/reactive MW across requests. RAD260049805 is a 35kV BSK EPC with unknown initial and actual prices, not a free contract.
source_discovery_note: Four added 2025 Rosseti 223-FZ records are indexed source leads; none of their original protocols has been read or primary contract prices confirmed.
technical_family_note: СТК/SVC (thyristor controlled) distinct from СТАТКОМ/STATCOM (voltage-source converter), confirmed by Russian FACTS standard СТО 56947007-29.240.019-2009.

source_conflicts.reason: Lot total must reconcile to original EtP joint amount; Kontur/KPSHKA 08 kopeck below TenderMedia.

market_caveat: 71 discovered lot-level leads, NOT 71 signed contracts or 71 unique EIS notices. Two BESK lots belong to one joint notice. Rosseti 452m amount is initial notice value with unclear nominal compensation voltage and mixed commodity classifier up to 1kV; never interpret as installed 6-35kV market value. No awards for new notices verified. Original primary-author document proves 110kV overall reactive power source with 10kV MPU, 335351974.38 RUB initial NET component price, NOT signed equipment contract or strictly 6-35kV entire-system NMC. 110kV BSK source line separate. Three project procurements share Tyazhinskaya underlying project but different design/supply deliverables.
